initialPrompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver one polished full-screen 1920x1080 16:9 Korean desktop GAME UI concept for FestaFiesta, a warm charming 3D low-poly Korean coastal festival construction/management game. This is an approval-only visual concept, not a runtime screenshot. Reference images show actual project style and scene. Preserve the visual identity: near-white pearl panels #F9F9FF, restrained icy cyan #91DFFF edge highlights, dark slate-purple text #3D3C4F, deep teal #286A79 primary actions, gold coin accents only for currency. Excellent high contrast Korean sans-serif, consistent 16px rounding, subtle pearl rim, clean line icons with TEXT LABELS, real hierarchy and generous breathing space; no excessive glass/transparency beneath body text, no neon cyberpunk. World occupies center: overhead 3D festival plaza, warm cream paving, trees, teal lampposts, string lights, small crafted booths. Keep bottom 96px visually quiet with a muted existing-looking shared prep HUD strip; do not invent a new HUD. Top-left small '건설' back control, top center 688x72 compact 7-tool dock with icon+label '다중 선택', '격자', '간격', '시설 범위', '건축 설정', '시설 목록', '조작 안내'; no F1-F7 labels. Top right gold pill '골드 10,000'. Crisp straight-on flat screen UI, no device frame, no OS border, no watermark, no explanatory arrows or annotations on the game view. Do not invent health bars, gems, avatars, XP, or mobile navigation. Korean text should be accurate. Use provided existing scene and booths as visual references, avoid copying the messy existing panel layout.
SCREEN 1 — FACILITY CATALOG. Center upper two-thirds is open warm festival world. Bottom dock at x24 y640 width1872 height336. Solid pearl panel with subtle teal border. Row1 category chips with simple relevant icons: '전체' (selected), '부스', '화장실', '안내', '휴게', '공연', '안전', '포토스팟', '조명', '길', '타일'. Row2 '전체 시설' at left, '즐겨찾기만', input '시설 검색', '조합 도감', '매출 순위' at right. Horizontal row of 9 clear equally sized 184x210 cards with184-pixel width and10 gaps, thumbnails162x104, at y750. Stylized real miniature booth renders isolated on white. Each card has distinct image, two-line name space, star favorite top right, gold cost in separate aligned bottom region. Example names/prices: '메인공연장' '0 Gold' with small '필수 0/1' coral badge; '게임장' '300 Gold'; '농구 슛 챌린지' '300 Gold'; '리듬 게임 부스' '300 Gold'; '미니 양궁장' '300 Gold'; '보드게임 텐트' '300 Gold'; '서핑 밸런스 체험장' '300 Gold'; '풍선 다트 부스' '300 Gold'; '나만의 부채 공방' '300 Gold' with tiny lavender '연계' tag. The selected card gets teal2px edge and a clear check/selected indicator. Keep required warning a SMALL badge, do not tint entire required card alarming red. Show clear horizontal scroll cue. Overall refined welcoming festival UI, not corporate dashboard.
